provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Mistborn: The Deckbuilding Game rulebook V1 (1st printing)

modules.name: Co-op vs the Lord Ruler
modules.note: Always on for solo. No Target and no starting bonuses.

steps.text: Deal each player a random character card
Training track and a cube in your color, cube on the first step
Set of {n} metal tokens on the marked spaces above the track
Shuffle your character's 4 Training cards with {n} Funding cards as your deck
Health dial set to {n}
Put unused player components back in the box, including their Training and Funding cards
Shuffle the Market deck and reveal {n} cards in a row: the Market
Boxings and Atium tokens next to the Market
Reveal {n} random Mission cards; return the rest
One cube of each player's color on each Mission, on the image at the right
Leave the Target standee in the box
Dominance track card in view, Lord Ruler card on top so only its title bar shows
Lord Ruler health dial set to {n}
His {n}-card deck next to the Dominance card
Pick a first player. Clockwise bonuses: {bonus}
Give the Target to the last player in turn order
Pick a random first player; no starting bonuses
Everyone draws {n} cards
You start able to Burn only {n} metal per turn
End of turn: discard everything except Allies, then draw {n}
Win: top of all 3 Mission tracks, last one standing, or 4 Atium on Confrontation
After drawing your new hand, draw and resolve the top Lord Ruler card
You lose if the Lord Ruler's deck runs out
Edicts heal him 10 for each Mission nobody has completed
First player takes a turn: play cards, Burn metals, buy from the Market, attack
At the end of each turn, that player draws a Lord Ruler card
